recognize_zh: 血片中多個異常細胞的核有摺痕或呈雙葉狀，細胞質帶細小、稀疏的顆粒而非粗大顆粒，高核質比，這種核型態搭配缺乏明顯顆粒的細胞質要想到低顆粒型 APL（M3v）。
features: Medium to large cells with high to moderate N:C ratio
Nuclei folded, indented or bilobed with overlapping lobes
Fine, delicate chromatin; small inconspicuous nucleoli
Basophilic to gray-blue cytoplasm with very fine, sparse granules; some cells appear agranular
Irregular cytoplasmic borders with small blebs
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; platelets sparse
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous atypical medium-to-large cells with folded, indented to bilobed nuclei, fine chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderately basophilic with only fine, sparse granules, and several cells appear nearly agranular; Auer rods are not evident in this field. Platelets are sparse. Findings are suggestive of the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; PML::RARA testing and DIC screening should be performed urgently.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have folded nuclei but more abundant gray cytoplasm with vacuoles and are NSE positive, MPO weak, and often HLA-DR positive, unlike APL.
AML with inv(16) shows myelomonocytic blasts plus abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules and is CBFB::MYH11 positive rather than PML::RARA.

ddx.dx: Sézary syndrome/large cell T-lymphoma in blood
ddx.vs: Sézary cells have convoluted cerebriform nuclei with dense chromatin and are MPO negative, CD4 positive by flow.
